tasks.label: MCP: SSE endpoint smoke
args: $tmp = Join-Path $env:TEMP ('mcp-sse-' + [guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N') + '.txt'); $null = curl.exe -sN --max-time 2 http://localhost:8080/sse 2>$null | Tee-Object -FilePath $tmp; if (Select-String -Path $tmp -Pattern 'event: endpoint' -Quiet) { Get-Content $tmp } else { Write-Error 'MCP SSE endpoint event not observed' }

tasks.label: Auto: ensure kernel running
args: $h = $null; try { $h = Invoke-RestMethod 'http://localhost:8000/healthz' -TimeoutSec 5 } catch {}; if ($null -eq $h -or $h.status -ne 'ok') { Start-Process -FilePath 'powershell' -WindowStyle Hidden -ArgumentList @('-NoLogo','-NoProfile','-ExecutionPolicy','Bypass','-Command','Set-Location ''${workspaceFolder}\..\moos\platform\kernel''; go run ./cmd/moos --kb ''${workspaceFolder}\.agent\kb'' --hydrate *>> ''${workspaceFolder}\.agent\dev\vscode-kernel-autostart.log''') | Out-Null; Write-Output 'Kernel start requested.' } else { Write-Output 'Kernel already healthy.' }

tasks.label: Auto: ensure vscode-ai listener
args: $p = Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.Name -match 'pwsh|powershell' -and $_.CommandLine -match 'antigraviti-auto-listen.ps1' -and $_.CommandLine -match 'vscode-ai' } | Select-Object -First 1; if ($null -eq $p) { Start-Process -FilePath 'pwsh' -WindowStyle Hidden -ArgumentList @('-NoLogo','-NoProfile','-ExecutionPolicy','Bypass','-File','${workspaceFolder}\.agent\dev\antigraviti-auto-listen.ps1','-AgentUrn','urn:moos:agent:vscode-ai','-AgentName','VS Code AI','-AgentTag','vscode-ai','-AssignedTo','vscode-ai','-SessionUrn','','-ObserveOnly','-NoStatusMessage','-StateFile','.vscode-ai-auto-listener-state.json','-LogFile','vscode-ai-auto-listen.log','-MutexName','Local\FFS0_VSCodeAI_AutoListen','-StartFromNow') | Out-Null; Write-Output 'vscode-ai listener started.' } else { Write-Output 'vscode-ai listener already running.' }

tasks.label: Auto: ensure antigraviti listener
args: $p = Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.Name -match 'pwsh|powershell' -and $_.CommandLine -match 'antigraviti-auto-listen.ps1' -and $_.CommandLine -match 'antigraviti' -and $_.CommandLine -notmatch 'vscode-ai' } | Select-Object -First 1; if ($null -eq $p) { Start-Process -FilePath 'pwsh' -WindowStyle Hidden -ArgumentList @('-NoLogo','-NoProfile','-ExecutionPolicy','Bypass','-File','${workspaceFolder}\.agent\dev\antigraviti-auto-listen.ps1','-AgentUrn','urn:moos:agent:antigraviti','-AgentName','Antigraviti','-AgentTag','antigraviti','-AssignedTo','antigraviti','-SessionUrn','urn:moos:session:antigraviti-autolistener','-StateFile','.antigraviti-auto-listener-state.json','-LogFile','antigraviti-auto-listen.log','-MutexName','Local\FFS0_Antigraviti_AutoListen','-StartFromNow') | Out-Null; Write-Output 'antigraviti listener started.' } else { Write-Output 'antigraviti listener already running.' }

tasks.label: Auto: ensure triangle watcher
args: $p = Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.Name -match 'pwsh|powershell' -and $_.CommandLine -match 'triangle-watcher' } | Select-Object -First 1; if ($null -eq $p) { Start-Process -FilePath 'powershell' -WindowStyle Hidden -ArgumentList '-NoLogo -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File ${workspaceFolder}\.agent\scripts\triangle-watcher.ps1' | Out-Null; Write-Output 'triangle-watcher started.' } else { Write-Output 'triangle-watcher already running.' }
